newsitem.title: USA: Walbro sees slight Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Walbro sees slight Q4 loss.

text.p: Walbro Corp said it expects to report a slight loss for the fourth quarter of 1996.

Chief executive L.E. Althaver said that, in addition to the factors disclosed in December, fourth quarter and full year 1996 earnings would be lower than analysts' revised estimates, primarily due to weaker than expected sales in certain areas.
"Worldwide orders from Walbro Engine Management's lawn-and-garden customers were impacted by customer requests in the fourth quarter to defer product shipments," he said.
"The company also experienced an inventory adjustment at its Norwegian operations," he said.

In addition, income from the Marwal do Brasil joint venture in South America and Marwal Systems joint venture in France were below expectations due to weaker than expected demand from the ventures' automotive customers in these markets, he said. "Notwithstanding these issues, the outlook for 1997 remains positive based, in part, on new plastic fuel tank programs which will start in the second half of the year," said the chief of the maker of fuel systems.
The company reported earnings of $0.30 per share for the fourth quarter of 1995.
